props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: form
props.description:
Identifies the form that owns the radio inputs.
Useful when the radio group is rendered outside the form.

props.name: value
props.description:
The controlled value of the radio item that should be currently selected.

To render an uncontrolled radio group, use the `defaultValue` prop instead.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The uncontrolled value of the radio button that should be initially selected.

To render a controlled radio group, use the `value` prop instead.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback fired when the value changes.

props.name: style

Style applied to the element, or a function that

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: id
